entities.name: Tuíre Kayapó
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Tuíre Kayapó, also called Tuíra, was a Brazilian indigenous rights activist, environmentalist, and a chief of the Kayapó people. She was active in the movement against the Belo Monte Dam project on the Xingu River in the 1980s and constitutional amendment PEC 215 in the 2010s.

entities.summary: Tuíre Kayapó, also called Tuíra, was a Brazilian indigenous rights activist, environmentalist, and a chief of the Kayapó people. She was active in the movement against the Belo Monte Dam project on the Xingu River in the 1980s and constitutional amendment PEC 215 in the 2010s.
